run_RSInferencer_from_config: run remote sensing inference on a GeoTIFF image using RSInferencer.from_config_path with a model config and checkpoint
run_RSInferencer_from_model: run remote sensing inference on a GeoTIFF image using RSInferencer.from_model with an existing BaseModel
create_RSImage_grids: create sliding window grids for a remote sensing image using RSImage.create_grids with a specified window size and stride
read_RSImage_data: read remote sensing image data from a GeoTIFF file using RSImage.read with an optional grid region
create_RSImage_seg_map: create a segmentation map GeoTIFF output file using RSImage.create_seg_map with a specified output path
